title: Toon band shading material
purpose: Cel-shade three.js meshes with a fixed number of soft-edged light bands, a hard specular spot and a lit-side rim through one ShaderMaterial whose band math has an exact CPU mirror. Use it for stylized characters, props and game scenes.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: three.js r155 or later passed in as THREE (the shader includes the colorspace_fragment chunk); only 0.186.1 was run.

contract.language: ECMAScript 2020 module; GLSL ES 3.00 through three.js ShaderMaterial

exports.name: createToonBandMaterial
exports.summary: The toon material; options are the keys of TOON_BAND_DEFAULTS and an unknown key throws TypeError.

exports.name: toonBandLevel
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the shader band function: the lit level in [0, 1] for a Lambert term in [-1, 1].

exports.name: toonLightDirection
exports.summary: Unit vector from the target toward the light, for uLightDirection.

exports.name: TOON_BAND_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default options; colours are linear RGB triples.

exports.name: TOON_BAND_GLSL
exports.summary: GLSL function float toonBandLevel(float nDotL, float bands, float softness).

exports.name: TOON_BAND_VERTEX
exports.summary: Vertex stage: world normal and position, InstancedMesh aware.

exports.name: TOON_BAND_FRAGMENT
exports.summary: Fragment stage: bands, specular spot, rim, tone mapping and output colour space.

options.name: color
options.meaning: Lit colour (linear RGB triple, hex number, CSS string or THREE.Color).

options.name: softness
options.meaning: Half width of each band edge in Lambert units.

options.name: lightDirection
options.meaning: Direction toward the light in world space; normalized by the builder.

options.name: specularColor
options.meaning: Colour added by the specular spot.

options.name: specularSize
options.meaning: Spot size as 1 - cos of its angular radius; 0 turns it off.

limits: Stylized, not physically based. One directional light given as a direction uniform: three.js scene lights, shadows, fog and environment maps are ignored. Specular and rim are thresholded tricks without energy conservation. Skinned and morphed meshes are not deformed (the vertex stage reads position and normal only); InstancedMesh works. Normals use an inverse-transpose per vertex so non-uniform scale shades correctly, at the cost of a matrix inverse per vertex. Written for three.js r155 or later; only 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2. Hardware GPUs, other browsers and WebGPU were not run.
technique_references: Lambert term quantized into bands with smoothstep edges
Blinn half-vector specular thresholded into a spot
